note: Set B is significantly better because it correctly extracts critical equipment specifications from the Notes section (Inverter power, Breaker ratings, Enclosure types) which Set A misses entirely. Both sets struggle with binding Wiring Schedule symbol IDs to their descriptions (e.g., both attribute Symbol 20's data to Symbol 50 or shift 31/32/33/34), resulting in a similar number of wrong wiring claims. However, Set B's inclusion of accurate system-level data makes it much more useful and complete.
